title: Beginning Steps of working on pixel art games
author: Nicstar543
selftext:
Hey everyone, I built my own pixel art studio tool to work on pixel art, I essentially have codex create the rough pieces, and then i use this to bring them all into more cohesive art pieces. This is really just an example of the beginning steps of each, and then ones that are outliers and look terrible still I just go in and edit myself as you can see with the bowman. The sprite sheet I would just generate a "pixel" sprite and have kling (lately a comfyui LORA to not spend money), and use the frame picker inside the tool to choose the walk frames I want, this one didn't turn out too great but i didn't refine it all too much before hand. This was more a quick example of it all. 

Not looking to sell or give out as it's really customized to myself and would be impossible to explain, but just showing off you can do a lot with creating your own pixel studio to handle this kind of stuff!
